extraction.notes: Three-month column for Dec 31, 2022 from the Statements of Operations, FFO & CORE FFO page (seq 30). The company has no AFFO metric; its adjusted FFO is CFFO, so affo fields are null. Recomputed FFO (70,262) and CFFO (66,775) tie to the printed totals. Shares: 229,994,927 weighted average common shares and OP units, shown in thousands (229,994.927), reproduces FFO/share $0.31 and CFFO/share $0.29. 'Loan (premium accretion) discount amortization, net' is a loan (investment) item, not debt, so I used 'other' rather than debt_cost_amortization. 'Prepayment (gains) losses on asset dispositions' is tagged debt_extinguishment because it relates to debt prepayment costs in dispositions (the FFO line excludes these prepayment amounts); this is a judgment call. Recurring capex of $4.6 million is from the highlights section (seq 6, printed p.4), rounded to $0.1 million, so the figure of 4,600 (thousands) is approximate; the company gives no exact figure there."
